newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil shares close higher amid options jostling.
newsitem.headline: Brazil shares close higher amid options jostling.

text.p: Brazilian stocks closed higher in moderate trade led by rises in major blue chips amid jostling ahead of Feb. 17 options expiries and boosted by a rising real on local currency markets, brokers said.
"The market was firm today," said John Carioba of Indusval brokerage. "We saw a lot of sell orders but prices didn't fall."
The Sao Paulo bourse's Bovespa index of 49 most-traded shares climbed 1.65 percent to end at 80,959 points in moderate turnover of 475.4 million reais ($454 million).
